verses: Yeh hai woh surat jo hum ney nazil farmaee hai aur muqarrar kerdi hai aur jiss mein hum ney khulli aayaten (ehkaam) utaray hain takay tum yaad rakho

Zina-kaar aurat o mard mein say her aik ko so koray lagao. Unn per Allah ki shareeat ki hadd jari kertay huye tumhen hergiz taras na khana chahaye, agar tumhen Allah per aur qayamat kay din per eman ho. Unn ki saza kay waqt musalmanon ki aik jamat mojood honi chahaye
Zaani mard ba-juz zaaniya ya mushrika aurat kay aur say nikkah nahi kerta aur zina-kaar aurat bhi ba-juz zaani ya mushrik mard kay aur say nikkah nahi kerti aur eman walon per yeh haram kerdiya gaya
Jo log pak daman aurton per zinna ki tohmat lagayen phir char gawah na paish saken to unhen ussi koray lagao aur kabhi bhi unn ki gawahi qabool na kero. Yeh fasiq log hain
Haan jo log uss kay baad tauba aur islaah kerlen to Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala aur meharbani kerney wala hai

Jo log apni biwiyon per bad-kaari ki tohmat layen aur unn ka koi gawah ba-juz khud unn ki zaat kay na ho to aisay logon mein say her aik ka saboot yeh hai kay char martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker kahen kay woh sachon mein say hain
Aur paanchwen martaba kahey kay uss per Allah Taalaa ki laanat ho agar woh jhooton mein say ho
Aur uss aurat say saza uss tarah door hosakti hai kay woh char martaba Allah ki qasam kha ker kahey kay yaqeenan uss ka mard jhoot bolney walon mein say hai
Aur paanchwen dafa kahey kay uss per Allah Taalaa ka ghazab ho agar uss ka khawind sachon mein say ho
Agar Allah Taalaa ka fazal o karam tum per na hota (to tum per mushaqqat utarti) aur Allah Taalaa tauba qabool kerney wala ba-hikmat hai

Jo log yeh boht bara bohtan bandh laye hain yeh bhi tum mein say hi aik giroh hai. Tum ussay apney liye bura na samjho, balkay)yeh yeh to tumharay haq mein behtar hai. Haan unn mein say her aik shakhs per itna gunah hai jitna uss ney kamaya hai aur unn mein say jiss ney uss kay boht baray hissay ko anjam diya hai uss kay liye azab bhi boht hi bara hai
Ussay suntay hi momin mardon aurton ney apney haq mein nek gumani kiyon na ki aur kiyon na keh diya kay yeh to khullam khulla sareeh bohtan hai
Woh uss per char gawah kiyon na laye? Aur jab gawah nahi laye to yeh bohtan baaz log yaqeenan Allah kay nazdeek mehaz jhootay hain
Agar Allah Taalaa ka fazal o karam tum per duniya aur aakhirat mein na hota to yaqeenan tum ney jiss baat kay charchay shuroo ker rakhay thay uss baray mein tumhen boht bara azab phonchta

Jab kay tum ussay apni zabano say naqal dar naqal kerney lagay aur apney mun say woh baat nikalney lagay jiss ki tumhen mutlaq khabar na thi, go tum ussay halki baat samajhtay rahey lekin Allah Taalaa kay nazdeek woh boht bari baat thi
Tum ney aisi baat ko suntay hi kiyon na keh diya kay humen aisi baat mun say nikalni bhi laeeq nahi. Ya Allah! to pak hai, yeh to boht bara bohtan hai aur tohmat hai
Allah Taalaa tumhen naseehat kerta hai kay phir kabhi bhi aisa kaam na kerna agar tum sachay momin ho
Allah Taalaa tumharay samney apni aayaten biyan farma raha hai, aur Allah Taalaa ilm o hikmat wala hai
Jo log musalmanon mein bey-hayai phelaney kay mand rehtay hain unn kay liye duniya aur aakhirat mein dard-naak azab hain, Allah sab kuch janta hai aur tum kuch bhi nahi jantay
Agar tum per Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat na hoti aur yeh bhi kay Allah Taalaa bari shafqat rakhney wala meharban hai. (to tum per azab utar jata)

Eman walo! shetan kay qadam qadam na chalo. Jo shakhs shetani qadmon ki pairwee keray to woh to bey-hayai aur buray kaamon ka hi hukum keray ga. Aur agar Allah Taalaa ka fazal o karam tum per na hota to tum mein say koi kabhi bhi pak saaf na hota. Lekin Allah Taalaa jissay pak kerna chahaye, ker deta hai. Aur Allah sab sunnay wala sab jannay wala hai

Tum mein say jo buzrugi aur kushadgi walay hain unhen apney qarabat daron aur miskeenon aur mohajiron ko fi sabeelillah Allah denay say qasam na kha leni chahaye, balkay)yeh moaf ker dena aur darguzar ker lena chahaye. Kiya tum nahi chahatay kay Allah Taalaa tumharay qusoor moaf farma dey? Allah qasooron ko moaf farmaney wala meharban hai
Jo log pak daman bhooli bhali ba-emaan aurton per tohmat lagatay hain woh duniya o aakhirat mein malaoon hain aur unn kay liye bara bhari azab hai
Jab kay unn kay muqablay mein unn ki zabanen aur unn kay hath paon unn kay aemaal ki gawahi den gay
Uss din Allah Taalaa unhen poora poora badla haq o insaf kay sath dey ga aur woh jaan len gay kay Allah Taalaa hi haq hai (aur o hi) zahir kerney wala hai

Khabees aurten khabees mardon kay laeeq hain aur khabees mard khabees aurton kay laeeq hain aur pak aurten pak mardon kay laeeq hain aur pak mard pak aurton kay laeeq hain. Aisay pak logon kay mutalliq jo kuch bakwas (bohtan baaz) ker rahey hain woh unn say bilkul buri hain, unn kay liye bakhsish hai aur izzat wali rozi

Aey eman walo! apney gharon kay siwa aur gharon mein na jao jab tak kay ijazat na ley lo aur o haan kay rehney walon ko salam na kerlo, yehi tumharay liye sirasir behtar hai takay tum naseehat hasil kero

Agar o haan tumhen koi bhi na mill sakay to phir ijazat milay baghair andar na jao. Agar tum say lot janey ko kaha jaye to tum lot hi jao, yehi baat tumharay liye pakeezah hai, jo kuch tum ker rahey ho Allah Taalaa khoob janta hai
Haan ghair abad gharon mein jahan tumhara koi faeedah ya asbaab ho, janey mein tum per koi gunah nahi. Tum jo kuch bhi zahir kertay ho aur jo chupatay ho Allah Taalaa sab kuch janta hai
Musalman mardon say kaho kay apni nigahen neechi rakhen, aur apni sharamghaon ki hifazat rakhen. Yehi unn kay liye pakeezgi hai, log jo kuch keren Allah Taalaa sab say khabardaar hai

Musalman aurton say kaho kay woh bhi apni nigahen neechi rakhen aur apni asmat mein farq na aaney den aur apni zeenat ko zahir na keren, siwaye uss kay jo zahir hai aur apney girbano per apni orhniyan dalay rahen, aur apni aaraeesh ko kissi kay samney zahir na keren, siwaye apney khawindon kay ya apney walid kay ya apney khusar kay ya apney larkon kay ya apney khawind kay larkon kay ya apney bhaiyon kay ya apney bhatijon kay ya apney bhanjon kay ya apney mail jol ki aurton kay ya ghulamon kay ya aisay naukar chaakar mardon kay jo shehwat walay na hun ya aisay bachon kay jo aurton kay parday ki baaton say mutlaa nahi. Aur uss tarah zor zor say paon maar ker na chalen kay unn ki posheedah zeenat maloom hojaye, aey musalmano! tum sab kay sab Allah ki janab mein tauba kero takay tum nijat pao

Tum mein say jo mard aurat nikah kay hun unn ka nikkah ker do aur apney nek bakht ghulam aur londiyon ka bhi. Agar woh muflis bhi hun gay to Allah Taalaa unhen apney fazal say ghani bana dey ga. Allah Taalaa kushadgi wala aur ilm wala hai

Aur unn logon ko pak daman rehna chahaye jo apna nikkah kerney ka maqdoor nahi rakhtay yahan tak kay Allah Taalaa unhen apney fazal say maaldaar bana dey, tumharay ghulamon mein jo koi kuch tumhen dey ker azadi ki tehreer kerani chahaye to tum aisi tehreer unhen kerdiya kero agar tum ko unn mein koi bhalaee nazar aati ho. Aur Allah ney jo maal tumhen dey rakha hai uss mein say unhen bhi do, tumhari jo londiyan pak daman rehna chahati hain unhen duniya ki zindagi kay faeeday ki gharz say bad-kaari per majboor na kero aur jo unhen majboor kerdey to Allah Taalaa unn per jabar kay baad bakhsish denay wala aur meharbani kerney wala hai
Hum ney tumhari taraf khulli aur roshan aayaten utaar di hain aur unn logon ki kahwaten jo tum say pehlay guzar hain aur perhezgaron kay liye naseehat

Allah noor hai aasmano aur zamin ka, uss kay noor ki misal misil aik taaq kay hai jiss mein chiragh ho aur chiragh sheesha ki qandeel mein ho aur sheesha misil chamaktay huye roshan sitaray kay ho woh chiragh aik ba-barkat darakht zaitoon kay tel say jalaya jata ho jo darakht na mashriqi hai na maghribi khud woh tel qareeb hai kay aap hi roshni denay lagay agarcheh ussay aag na bhi chuye, noor per noor hai, Allah Taalaa apney noor ki taraf rehnumaee kerta hai jissay chahaye, logon (kay samjhaney) ko yeh misalen Allah Taalaa biyan farma raha hai, aur Allah Taalaa her cheez kay haal say bakhoobi waqif hai
Unn gharon mein jin kay buland kerney, aur jin mein apney naam ki yaad ka Allah Taalaa ney hukum diya hai o haan subha o shaam Allah Taalaa ki tasbeeh biyan kertay hain

Aisay log jinhen tijarat aur khareed khareed-o-farokht Allah kay zikar say aur namaz kay qaeem kerney aur zakat ada kerney say ghafil nahi kerti uss din say dartay hain jiss din boht say dil aur boht si aankhen ulat palat hojayen gi
Uss iraday say kay Allah unhen unn kay aemaal ka behtareen badlay dey balkay)yeh apney fazal say aur kuch ziyadti ata farmaye. Allah Taalaa jissay chahaye be-shumaar roziyan deta hai

Aur kafiron kay aemaal misil uss chamakti hui rait kay hain jo chatyal maidan mein ho jissay piayasa shakhs door say pani samjhta hai lekin jab uss kay pass phonchta hai to ussay kuch bhi nahi pata, haan Allah ko apney pass pata hai jo uss ka hisab poora poora chuka deta hai. Allah boht jald hisab kerdenay wala hai

Ya misil unn andheron kay hai jo nihayat gehray samandar ki teh mein hun jissay upper talay ki mojon ney dhaanp rakha ho, phir upper say badal chaye huye hun. Al-gharz andheriyan hain jo upper talay pay darpay hain. Jab apna hath nikalay to ussay bhi qareeb hai kay na dekh sakay, aur (baat yeh hai kay) jissay Allah Taalaa hi noor na dey uss kay pass koi roshni nahi hoti

Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zamin ki kul makhlooq aur per phelaye urney walay kul parind Allah ki tasbeeh mein mashghool hain. Her aik ki namaz aur tasbeeh ussay maloom hai, log jo kuch keren uss say Allah bakhoobi waqif hai
Zamin o aasman ki badshahat Allah hi ki hai aur Allah Taalaa hi ki taraf lotna hai

Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay Allah Taalaa badlon ko chalata hai, phir unhen milata hai phir unhen teh ba teh ker deta hai, phir aap dekhtay hain kay unn kay darmiyan mein say meenh barasta hai. O hi aasman ki janib say olon kay pahar mein say olay barsata hai, phir jinhen chahaye unn kay pass unhen barsaye aur jin say chahaye unn say unhen hata dey. Badal hi say nikalney wali bijli ki chamak aisi hoti hai kay goya abb aankhon ki roshni ley chali
Allah Taalaa hi din aur raat ko radd-o-badal kerta rehta hai aankhon walon kay liye to uss mein yaqeenan bari bari ibraten hain

Tamam kay tamam chalney phirney walay jaandaron ko Allah Taalaa hi ney pani say peda kiya hai unn mein say baaz to apney pet kay bal chaltay hain, baaz do paon per chaltay hain. Baaz char paon per chaltay hain, Allah Taalaa jo chahata hai peda kerta hai. Be-shak Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Bila-shak o shuba)yeh hum ney roshan aur wazeh aayaten utaar di hain Allah Taalaa jissay chahaye seedhi raah dikha deta hai
Aur kehtay hain kay hum Allah Taalaa aur rasool per eman laye aur farman bardaar huye, phir unn mein say aik firqay uss kay baad bhi phir jata hai. Yeh eman walay hain (hi) nahi
Jab yeh uss baat ki taraf bulaye jatay hain kay Allah aur uss ka rasool unn kay jhagray chuka dey to bhi unn ki aik jamat mun morney wali bann jati hai
Haan agar unn hi ko haq phonchta ho to mutee o farman bardaar ho ker uss ki taraf chalay aatay hain

Kiya unn kay dilon mein beemari hai? Ya yeh shak o shuba)yeh mein paray huye hain? Ya unhen uss baat ka darr hai kay Allah Taalaa aur uss ka rasool unn ki haq talfi na keren? Baat yeh hai kay yeh log khud hi baray zalim hain

Eman walon ka qol to yeh hai kay jab unhen uss liye bulaya jata hai kay Allah aur uss ka rasool unn mein faisla kerdey to woh kehtay hain kay hum ney suna aur maan liya. Yehi log kaamyaab honey walay hain
Jo bhi Allah Taalaa ki, uss kay rasool ki farman bardari keren, khof elahi rakhen aur uss kay azabon say dartay rahen, o hi nijat paney walay hain

Bari pukhtagi kay sath Allah Taalaa ki qasmen kha kha ker kehtay hain kay aap ka hukum hotay hi nikal kharay hun gay. Keh dijiye kay bus qasmen na khao (tumhari) ita’at (ki haqeeqat) maloom hai. Jo kuch tum ker rahey ho Allah Taalaa uss say ba-khabar hai

Keh dijiye kay Allah Taalaa ka hukum mano, rasool Allah ki ita’at kero, phir bhi agar tum ney roo-gardani ki to rasool kay zimmay to sirf o hi hai jo uss per lazim kerdiya gaya hai aur tum per uss ki jawab dahi hai jo tum per rakha gaya hai hidayat to tumhen ussi waqt milay gi jab rasool ki ma-tehati kero. Suno rasool kay zimmay to sirf saaf tor per phoncha dena hai

Tum mein say unn logon say jo eman laye hain aur nek aemaal kiye hain Allah Taalaa wada farma chuka hai kay unhen zaroor zamin mein khalifa banaye ga jaisay kay unn logon ko khalifa banaya tha jo unn say pehlay thay aur yaqeenan unn kay liye unn kay uss deen ko mazbooti kay sath mohkum kerkay jama dey ga jissay unn kay liye woh pasand farma chuka hai aur unn kay uss khof khof-o-khatar ko woh aman mein say badal dey ga, woh meri ibadat keren gay meray sath kissi ko bhi shareek na thehrayen gay. Uss kay baad bhi jo log na-shukri aur kufur keren woh yaqeenan fasiq hain
Namaz ki pabandi kero, zakat ada kero aur Allah Taalaa kay rasool ki farmanbardari mein lagay raho takay tum per reham kiya jaye
Yeh khayal aap kabhi bhi na kerna kay munkir log zamin mein (udhar udhar bhaag ker) humen hara denay walay hain, unn ka asli thikana to jahannum hai jo yaqeenan boht hi bura thikana hai

Eman walo! tum say tumhari milkiyat kay ghulamon ko aur unhen bhi jo tum mein say balooghat ko na phonchay hun (apney aaney ki) teen waqton mein ijazat hasil kerni zaroori hai. Namaz fajar say pehlay aur zohar kay waqt jab kay tum apney kapray utaar rakhtay ho aur isha ki namaz kay baad, yeh teeno waqt tumhari (khilwat) aur pardah kay hain. Unn waqton kay ma-siwa na to tum per koi gunah hai na unn per. Tum sab aapas mein aik doosray kay pass ba-kasrat aaney janey walay ho (hi), Allah ussi tarah khol khol ker apney ehkaam tum say biyan farma raha hai. Allah Taalaa pooray ilm aur kamil hikmat wala hai

Aur tumharay bachay (bhi) jab balooghat ko phonch jayen to jiss tarah unn kay aglay log ijazat mangtay hain unhen bhi ijazat maang ker aana chahaye, Allah Taalaa tum say ussi tarah apni aayaten biyan farmata hai. Allah Taalaa hi ilm o hikmat wala hai

Bari boorhi aurten jinhen nikkah ki umeed (aur khuwahish hi) na rahi ho woh agar apney kapray utaar rakhen to unn per koi gunah nahi ba-shart-e-kay woh apna banao singhaar zahir kerney waliyan na hun, tahum agar unn say bhi ehtiyaat rakhen to unn kay liye boht afzal hai, aur Allah Taalaa sunta janta hai

Andhay per, langray per, beemar per aur khud tum per (mutlaqan) koi haraj nahi kay tum apney gharon say khalo ya apney baapon kay gharon say ya apni maaon kay gharon say ya apney bhaiyon kay gharon say ya apni behnon kay gharon say ya apney chachaon kay gharon say ya apni phoophiyon kay gharon say ya apney mamoo’on kay gharon say ya apni khalaon kay gharon say ya unn gharon say jin ki kunjiyon kay tum malik ho ya apney doston kay gharon say. Tum per uss mein bhi koi gunah nahi kay tum sab sath beth ker khana khao ya alag alag pus jab tum gharon mein janey lago to apney ghar walon ko salam kerliya kero duaa-e khair hai jo ba-barkat aur pakeezah hai Allah Taalaa ki taraf say nazil shuda, yun hi Allah Taalaa khol khol ker tum say apney ehkaam biyan farma raha hai takay tum samajh lo

Ba-emaan log to o hi hain jo Allah Taalaa per aur uss kay rasool per yaqeen rakhtay hain aur jab aisay moamla mein jiss mein logon kay jama honey ki zaroorat hoti hai nabi kay sath hotay hain to jab tak aap say ijazat na len kahen nahi jatay. Jo log aisay moqay per aap say ijazat ley letay hain haqeeqat mein yehi hain woh jo Allah Taalaa per aur uss kay rasool per eman chukay hain. Pus jab aisay log aap say apney kissi kaam kay liye ijazat talab keren to aap unn mein say jissay chahayen ijazat dey den aur unn kay liye Allah Taalaa say bakhsish ki dua maangen, be-shak Allah bakhshney wala meharban hai

Tum Allah Taalaa kay nabi kay bulanay ko aisa bulawa na kerlo jaisa kay aapas mein aik doosray ko hota hai. Tum mein say unhen Allah khoob janta hai jo nazar bacha ker chupkay say sirak jatay hain. Suno jo log hukum rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain unhen dartay rehna chahaye kay kahen unn per koi zabardast aafat na aa paray ya unhen dard naak azab na phonchay

Aagah ho jao kay aasman o zamin mein jo kuch hai sab Allah Taalaa hi ka hai. Jiss ravish per tum ho woh ussay bakhoobi janta hai, aur jiss din yeh sab uss ki taraf lotaye jayen gay uss din unn ko unn kay kiye say woh khabardaar ker dey ga. Allah Taalaa sab kuch jannay wala hai
